entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
None 
 -versus-
 State of Odisha & another .... Respondents
 Mr.Priyabrata Tripathy
 Addl.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Video Conferencing/Physical Mode).
Learned counsel for the State submitted notice issued to the informant is sufficient.

This is an appeal under section 14-A of S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, 1989 in connection with Spl. Case No.79 of 2022 arising out of Sahadevkhunta P.S. Case No.300 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned Special Court (SC & ST), Balasore for offences punishable under sections 394/307/
376(D)/34 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code read with section 3(2)(v) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act,
1989.
// 2 // The appellant moved an application for bail before the Court of learned Special Court (SC &
ST), Balasore, which was rejected on 20.10.2022.

In view of the statement of the victim and the nature of accusation and since the petitioner has been named in the F.I.R. as an accused, at this stage, I am not inclined to release the appellant on bail.

sentences.text: The prayer for bail stands rejected.
However, the petitioner is at liberty to renew the prayer for bail after examination of the victim in the learned trial Court.
The learned trial Court shall do well to expedite the trial and after framing of charge, take steps for examination of the victim and her husband at the first instance.
A copy of the order be communicated to the learned trial Court for compliance.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge Sipun Sonu @ Debendra Singh vs State Of Odisha & Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177046709/
